title: Megabazus son of Zopyrus
summary: Raleigh names Megabazus son of Zopyrus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Megabazus, another of the name, the sonne of Zopyrus, who arriued in Aegypt, chased the Athenians from Memphis, and recouered the Countrey. He is not the Megabazus sent to Sparta with Treasure. The one-word title would fold onto that Megabazus, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
